mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, r.version, r.environment, r.description, r.status, r.operator, r.released_at AS releasedAt, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM release_record r LEFT JOIN project p ON r.project_id = p.id
mapper.select: WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO release_record (project_id, version, environment, description, status, operator, released_at, created_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{version}, #{environment}, #{description}, #{status}, #{operator}, #{releasedAt}, #{createdAt})
